headline: Amazon Says Its Data Centers Use 86% Less Water Than Industry Average
summary: Amazon says its data centers used 2.5 billion gallons of water in 2025 but achieved water efficiency levels 86% better than the industry average.

headline: Credo Wires Agentic AI With $10 Billion-Plus Market In Sight
summary: Credo is a leveraged play on the AI data-center interconnect cycle, with a $10B total addressable market and expanding optical growth opportunity.
